answer.proof:
have hS : S = ({8, -14} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rw [h₀ x]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hf : (x + 3 - 11) * (x + 3 + 11) = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num
